name: @boldkit/mcp

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search BoldKit neubrutalism UI components, charts, shapes, and blocks by natural-language description. Returns ranked matches with framework availability (react/vue).

query.description: Natural-language description, e.g. "toast notification" or "chart showing proportions"

framework.description: Target framework. Omit to auto-detect from the project package.json.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get full details for a BoldKit component: description, dependencies, registry URLs per framework, files, and docs link.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the exact shadcn / shadcn-vue CLI command to install BoldKit components into a project. Auto-detects React vs Vue from the project directory unless framework is given.

framework.description: Target framework. Omit to auto-detect from the project package.json.

projectDir.description: Project directory used for framework auto-detection. Defaults to the current working directory.

tools.name: install_components
tools.description: Install BoldKit components into a project by running the shadcn / shadcn-vue CLI. Returns the CLI output.

framework.description: Target framework. Omit to auto-detect from the project package.json.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the project to install into

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every item in the BoldKit registry (components, charts, shapes, blocks, templates), optionally filtered by framework.

framework.description: Target framework. Omit to auto-detect from the project package.json.
